name: raise-the-bar
description: Claude Code plugins for agent-written code that still has to be safe to ship: guard hooks, engineering skills and decision councils.

plugins.name: no-yolo
plugins.description: Guard hooks for agent-written code (the guardrails guard): secrets stopped at commit, no push to a protected branch without a recorded test pass and review of the exact code, and production locked until a human approves. With a second check in git's own pre-push hook, a read-only reviewer agent and four skills: you-shall-not-push, done-done, who-let-you-in and mind-the-headers. Formerly the guardrails plugin.

plugins.name: no-slop
plugins.description: Engineering skills that hold agent work to a senior bar: idea-to-ta-da, spaghetti-meter, find-the-snail, most-wanted-bugs, show-me-red, you-had-one-job, pixel-police, main-is-lava, bug-autopsy, future-me-problem, message-in-a-bottle, not-another-wip, no-great-question, no-comment, homework-for-humans, lost-in-translation and skill-issue, with a read-only reviewer agent. Formerly the craft plugin.

plugins.name: no-echo
plugins.description: Decision skills where opposed viewpoints argue one question and the dissent is kept: let-them-fight, rewrite-or-regret, but-should-we and what-could-go-wrong, with a read-only council seat agent. And story-or-snore, which turns the pitch into a story people stay awake for, with a script that checks the story still fits the facts. Formerly the council plugin.
